newsitem.title: KENYA: Cargo ship ablaze at Kenyan port.
newsitem.headline: Cargo ship ablaze at Kenyan port.

text.p: Fire fighters in Mombasa, Kenya's Indian Ocean port, battled a blaze on a loaded container ship, the m.v. Oyster Bay, which docked on Saturday with smoke pouring from a hold.
On Sunday port officials said the fire had been extinguished and salvage work had begun.
Containers stacked on the ship's deck were offloaded to enable firemen to tackle the fire.
None of the ship's crew was injured, officials said, and the cause of the fire had not been established.
The Oyster Bay sailed from Hong Kong last month, and had loaded cargo at Singapore and Colombo before sailing to Mombasa.
